text: Hiscox describes professional liability insurance for business consultants as protection against claims of negligence and judgment errors arising from professional services.

source.title: Business Consultant Insurance Professional & General Liability | Hiscox

value.data: Professional liability insurance can address consultant negligence and judgment-error claims.

text: The Hartford explains that consultant professional liability insurance can help cover legal fees and defense costs and can also help pay covered settlements and judgments.

source.title: Professional Liability Insurance for Consultants | The Hartford

value.data: Consultant professional liability insurance may help with legal defense costs, settlements, and judgments for covered claims.

text: Cornell's risk guidance says professional liability coverage for consultants can address claims involving negligence, personal injury such as libel and slander, work completed in the past, and employees or independent contractors.

source.title: Independent Consultant/Non-Specialist Professional Services Providers | Cornell

value.data: Cornell identifies negligence, libel and slander, past-completed work, and personnel or independent-contractor claims as examples of professional liability coverage.
